segments.name: IoT solutions and services
segments.description: Provides IoT integration, support and maintenance, business process outsourcing services and trading of IoT-related products to enterprises in Hong Kong.
segments.evidence: The CODM believes we have only one business segment, which is the provision of IoT solutions and services..

revenueModel.text: Clients pay the company for delivered IoT integration solutions, BPO services, IoT support and maintenance services, and trading sales of IoT-related products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenues consist of (i) IoT Integration Solutions Services; (ii) Business Process Outsourcing ("BPO") Services; (iii) IoT Support and Maintenance Services; and (iv) Trading of IoT-Related products.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company sold its Australian subsidiary QBS System Pty Ltd to a related party.
changes.evidence: On July 8, 2024, all 1,000 shares of QBS System Pty Ltd, a company incorporated in Australia were transferred by its sole shareholder QBS System to Wong Ka Ki for a consideration of AUD10,000.
